qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Longstanding enterprise relationships and systems integration scale, but structurally lacks pricing power as clients demand productivity pass-throughs.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12% & no pricing power, REJECT). Billable-hour IT consulting and services model faces persistent margin pressure from client cost-takeout mandates and generative AI delivery deflation, with sub-12% multi-cycle GAAP ROIC following large goodwill acquisitions (Altran, WNS).
qualitative.evidence: 5-year GAAP ROIC remains structurally sub-hurdle (~9-11%) due to €10B+ in goodwill and intangibles from serial M&A (Altran, WNS, Cloud4C). Operating margins are capped at ~13%. Labour-intensive consulting and IT services lack pricing power above inflation as enterprise clients routinely enforce productivity clawbacks, a headwind accelerating under AI automation.
